analysis.reasonEn: The downtrend continues for 3 consecutive days. RSI is attempting to exit oversold territory, but MACD histogram is still worsening. analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (81,905 KRW) vs SMA5 (96,176 KRW) / SMA20 (128,695 KRW) / SMA50 (168,890 KRW) — positioned at the lower end of the short-to-medium term downtrend
· Position relative to SMA100 (136,320 KRW) / SMA200 (95,701 KRW) — trading below mid-to-long term moving averages, maintaining strong bearish sentiment
· 52-week position (25.6%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.2 → 32.9) — attempting to exit oversold territory after entering
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3659.2880 → -4342.9782) — bearish trend continues and is worsening
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 73,820 KRW) + band width at 85.28% indicating a wide volatility range
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (68,045 KRW) — support level higher than Pivot S1 (35,103 KRW)
· Swing resistance level (95,500 KRW) — first resistance zone for a short-term rebound
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern (Lower High) — confirmed bearish pattern with declining highs
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.79x) — below average volume suggests insufficient momentum for a rebound
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend) — maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI's oversold exit attempt, MACD worsening, and lack of volume
